native_source_conditions.legal_information:
# Terms of use

If you use this website you consent to these terms of use. They may be updated without notice.

## Cloudflare 

This website may use Cloudflare functionality that is subject to it's own terms and conditions. For full information, see https://cloudflare.com.

Cloudflare collects usage data and may store an essential cookie for security reasons.

## Federation

This website uses information federated from other Lemmy servers, and from other servers using the ActivityPub protocol (e.g. Mastodon), collectively "servers". We make a best effort attempt to protect personal information, however, the nature of federated servers requires that some content comes from other servers, and at times your browser or app may load information directly from those servers, which can have privacy implications.

The Lemmy software is not created by this website, and no guarantees can be made. All data entered into this website (including personal information) should be considered public. We strongly recommend you do not enter personal information into this website. 

If you are not comfortable with user generated content coming from a large number of other servers who may have different content policies,  please do not use this website.

## Private information

Lemmy.nz collects information that may be personally identifiable information. 

Basic account information: If you register on this server, you may be asked to enter a username, an e-mail address and a password. You may also enter additional profile information such as a display name and biography, and upload a profile picture and header image. The username, display name, biography, profile picture and header image are always listed publicly, both on this website and on other websites where your public account details are federated to.

Content: Your posts and comments are public in the community you post to. In some cases it means they are delivered to different servers and copies are stored there. When you delete posts, a request is sent to other servers to remove their copy but there is no guarantee this is honoured. The action of voting on a post may not be visible through the website, however, these are effectively public. Your public user details, posts, comments, direct mesages, votes, and other actions may be sent to other servers running ActivityPub compatible software that may publicly display this content, including your votes on posts and comments. 

You grant us a licence to share your content (including images or other uploads) with other users, and other instances for the purposes of displaying to their users. You retain ownership of your content, and can remove your comments, posts, or account using website functionality. 

Direct mesages: Direct messages between users are not end-to-end encrypted, and may be sent to other servers that may display these in a different way. While normally these messages are only shown to the sending user and the receiving user, the message may be available to administrators of this website or other servers. If you need to send personal information or other sensitive information, you should use an end-to-end encrypted service such as Matrix.

This website is hosted in New Zealand, however, Cloudflare can see website activity and may use your data subject to their own [Privacy Policy](https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/) as an end user of their services.

If you choose to provide an email address, this may be sent to our email provider Mailgun in order to send you transactional emails (e.g. password reset). It may also be used to search Stop Forum Spam or other spam databases.

As described above, content you provide to this website may be sent to other servers ("federated") so users of those servers can view the content you post. These servers may be located outside of New Zealand.

## Acceptable use poilicy

You agree to follow the [Code of Conduct](https://threadiverse.nz/about/rules.html). We may use our discretion to disable your access to the website or a website user account for any reason, and we have the final say on this matter.

# Other content

Lemmy displays images and other content from other servers, which may cause the user to directly load this content. Content loaded from other servers may provide those servers with information including your IP address and browser user agent. The IP address can be used to identify your location, and the the user agent can contain information about your device, operating system, browser, and other technical information. IP addresses and user agents may also be stored in server logs both on this website and on other servers that your browser makes a connection to.

A full list of other servers that this website shares information with (other than Cloudflare) can be found at https://lemmy.nz/instances. Note that due to the federated nature of Lemmy and ActivityPub, new servers can be added to this list at any time; for example, if a user of this website subscribes to a community on a new instance, or if a user on a new instance subscribes to a Lemmy.nz community.

# Site usage by children

If this server is in the EU or the EEA: Our site, products and services are all directed to people who are at least 16 years old. If you are under the age of 16, per the requirements of the GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) do not use this site.

If this server is in the USA: Our site, products and services are all directed to people who are at least 13 years old. If you are under the age of 13, per the requirements of COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act) do not use this site.

# Abuse

This website does not allow abuse of members, and we make a good faith effort to remove content that does not align with our [Code of Conduct](https://threadiverse.nz/about/rules.html). This includes removing content that has come from other servers. The website contains functionality for users to report content, including content retrieved from other servers. Reports may go to moderators and administrators of this website, the website of the user that is being reported, and the website of the community that the content resides in. Reports may also be shared via other channels (e.g. Matrix) in order to coordinate spam and abuse removal across different servers.

If you feel a report has not been satisfactorily resolved, please direct message [@Dave@lemmy.nz](https://lemmy.nz/u/Dave). Alternatively you can message using Matrix at @bechorin:matrix.org, or post in the [public chat room](https://threadiverse.nz/about/chat.html) where more administrators and moderators can see the request.

## Cookies

Cookies are pieces of information the website stores in your browser. Cookies are  used for remembering that you are logged in, by storing a token that is associated with your account. Cloudflare may also use a cookie, used for detecting abuse and collecting usage information.

native_source_conditions.legal_information:
When you browse this website information, including IP, browser user agent and fedipub metadata, is sent to this site.  
  If you make an account with us, we may store your email address if you supply it, and it may be used for appropriate purposes (account verification emails, password resets, etc.)  
  We may use all information for reasonable purposes, such a spam prevention.
  We may also store some form or derivative of your password.  
  You should use a suitably strong password, and not re-use passwords across sites.
  If you would like your data stored here to be deleted, please contact an admin, or email deletions at feddit.uk.  
  Be aware that as this site uses ActivityPub, public posts can and will propogate to other sites in the Fediverse.  
  This means while we can delete our copy, public posts may remain on other sites.  
  You must be over 18 to use this site.  
You may not post content that is pornographic in nature.

### Complaints
Complaints about moderation decisions can either be raised publicly by the !feddituk@feddit.uk community or the [Matrix room](https://matrix.to/#/#feddit.uk:matrix.org). Complaints can be raised privately by direct messaging one of the admin either through the inbuilt direct messaging system or by direct messaging on Matrix, both of which are accessible from an admin's profile page.

We make no promises to carry any content or accounts and reserve the right to remove either for whatever reasons we see fit. You have a right to claim breach of contract if we remove or restrict access to content you created, or we suspend your account, in breach of these terms of service.

### Illegal content
We, the admins of feddit.uk, will try to the best of our abilities to remove illegal content as soon as it's made aware to us. Users can report illegal content through the inbuilt reporting functionality, or reach out on [Matrix](https://matrix.to/#/#feddit.uk:matrix.org) or through direct messages.

We do not use proactive technology to identify illegal content. 

#### Terrorism content
Content that seeks to glorify or in any way build support for prescribed terrorist organisation will be swiftly taken down and accounts will be suspended.

#### CSEA content
Content that depicts or glorifies child sexual exploitation will be swiftly taken down and accounts will be suspended.

#### Other priority illegal content
Content that engages in any of the offences laid out in [Section 7 of the Online Safety Act](https://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/2023/50/schedule/7/enacted) will be swiftly taken down and accounts will be suspended.
native_source_conditions.sidebar:
### Who are we?
Feddit.uk is UK-centric, with integration to the wider Fediverse.   
  We tend to focus on UK-interest communities, others are welcome.

  The name is a shortening of "federate it".  
  Want to share a thing? Share it with the fediverse, or, fed-it.  
- See it
- Like it?
- Feddit

### What are the rules here?
* No racism, sexism, homophobia, transphobia or xenophobia
  * See our [guidelines on transphobia](https://guide.feddit.uk/politics/transphobia.html) for more detail
* No incitement of violence or promotion of violent ideologies
* No harassment, dogpiling or doxxing of other users
* Do not share intentionally false or misleading information
* Do not spam or abuse network features.
* Alt accounts are permitted, but all accounts must list each other in their bios. 
* No generative AI content

Rules apply on this instance, and when using an account from this instance to interact with other instances.  
  Administrators may warn or ban for breaches of the rules, or the spirit of the rules.

### Where should I start?

If you are new, say "hello" over at !welcome@feddit.uk. We can offer any specific help you might need there. Other than that...

#### Here
- !unitedkingdom@feddit.uk for general UK news.
- !casualuk@feddit.uk for general chit-chat.
- !uk_politics@feddit.uk for politics.
- !memes@feddit.uk to watch us get arrested for stealing memes without a licence.
- !askuk@feddit.uk to find out where to get a meme licence.
- !andfinally@feddit.uk for silly news.
